reviews.summary: All nine Round 1 issues fixed and independently verified. Fidelity: the objective, causal admission gating, forced exact-prefill-overlap, unconditional max(remoteLeadUs, tAdmD), minMu = 1e-3, censored resident estimates, composite kernel reading only tau_ttft and tau_e2e, and the strict argmin threshold are unchanged from Round 1 -- no algebra regressed while fixing the plumbing; the joint D + DxP cross product and the decode pick on a local win are preserved and tested; the two previously-undeclared biases are closed rather than documented away (kvBlocks advances monotonically; both resident populations are ID-sorted so the estimator's stable sort has a deterministic input). Code quality: role-set matching factored so scoring and decline paths cannot drift; viewFor takes one lock hold; every comment that asserted a capability the code lacked is now accurate. Registration, config, overlay format, assembly and treatment-config criteria all verified by independent re-parse and re-run: go vet clean, golangci-lint 0 issues, 190 subtests pass with 0 skips, -race green across all four profilehandler packages. Both blocker fixes address the mechanism rather than the symptom, and the 1(b) documentation correction landed in all three required places. The absent leastttftjoint package is accepted as the comparator's scope and recorded as not-covered rather than claimed green. One optional non-blocking nit raised (Ablation type-level doc restating the decomposition claim unconditionally).
